_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Adds the six-tool Authorized Surface Contract protocol (surface_list/open/snapshot/query/act/close) plus read and atomic configure/test tools for the Discovery reference surface. The generic protocol replaces page-specific coworker tool growth, is force-budgeted as one universal perception/action capability, and re-enters existing governed domain tools for persistent effects. EP-F7E35344.

registry.packFiles.reason: Adds one generic surface-pack.ts for the versioned Authorized Surface Contract. It serves browser, mobile, workroom, scheduled, background, headless, and external callers through the same compact protocol instead of adding one pack per UX surface. EP-F7E35344.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
